responsibility: Project durable manual creation jobs and existing narrative reports; page navigation never owns cancellation. ADR-026 / US-SYN-003 AC-8/9/10.

outputs.visibleContent: Chronological native List, filters, actual job states, unread markers, explicit retry/cancel/delete and Focus result navigation
outputs.interactionTargets: creation-library-open; native row navigation, filter, retry, cancel and delete; creation-library-actions-{UUID}; creation-library-delete-{UUID}; creation-library-confirm-delete

orderingRule: Descending createdAt, UUID tie-break; automatic and manual results share one order.
emptyStateRule: No placeholder success; loading and errors differ from an empty library.
gestureRule: Row navigation only reads existing job state. Retry/cancel use independent borderless buttons; entering a row must not invoke them. Library-origin details return to the existing library without pushing another instance.
deletionRule: Manual and automatic entries offer a native row menu and trailing swipe. Both require confirmation; full swipe cannot delete immediately. Cancellation keeps the entry. Confirmed deletion preserves source memories, cancels active manual work, and uses existing report period invalidation. Failures keep the entry and show a persistent error until dismissed or a successful retry. Same-ID deletion waits for accepted submission/retry reservations before cancelling owned work and removing the entry.
resourceDeferralRule: Persist deferred outside L2/PendingOperations; show Waiting for device resources and explicit Continue. Opening or refreshing never replays work. Detail continuation target: creation-continue-resources.
